OVERALL DESCRIPTION

In this course, we present he basic statistical tools corresponding to the first stage of Data Analysis (numerical summaries and graphical representation of data). At the end of this course, the student will have acquired the concepts required for success in later courses (Inferential Statistics, Data Analysis, Econometrics, etc.)

PREREQUISITES

MS01-001-G Fondamentaux mathématiques

MS02-001-G Analyse Mathématique
